== chapter 34 ==

## The previous part ends

- t: ወይበላ ፡ ለንግሥት ፡ አሐውር ፡ እነጽር ፡ ገጸ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወእገብእ ፡ ዝየ ፡ በፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
- i: He said to the Queen: "I will go and see my father's face, and I will return here, by the will of God, the God of Israel."

Words in this part: 538.
